thread:
elaine: FYI after yesterday's short-kernel flip, p95 for tiny streaming responses jumped. preliminary profile points at host parse + grpc small-write syscalls.
nico: can you paste the hotspots?
elaine: short paste:
```
stack: ingress_handler -> parse_stream -> utf8_normalize -> writev_per_chunk -> grpc_stream_write -> epoll_wait
hotspots: writev_per_chunk (39%), utf8_normalize (21%), grpc_stream_write (13%)
```
devon: sounds like kernel sped up GPU path and shifted work to host. writev_per_chunk matches what we saw when flush_on_kv_miss was enabled.
pat: low-risk fixes: 1) host mini-aggregator (max_bytes, max_frames, timeout_ms) to coalesce small frames; 2) utf8 quick-check to skip normalize when input already NFC.
elaine: microbench: agg(max_frames=3,max_bytes=3072,timeout_ms=6) + utf8 quick-check -> p95 220ms -> 155ms on short streams, write syscalls -3.6x, proxy CPU +5%.
nico: KV note: holding frames can increase serialization on kv-shard leaders for long multi-frame miss flows. we need bypass rules.
devon: agree. proposal: default aggregator on; bypass if frame_count>8 OR body_size>80kb. tighten on kv_miss: bypass when frame_count>5. also add per-tenant opt-out.
pat: add telemetry before broad rollout: histograms host.preproc.normalize_ms, counters host.streamer.writev_calls, histo host.streamer.agg_held_bytes, tagged counter host.streamer.agg_bypass_reason.
elaine: added metrics and pushed branch. ops-bot: canary deploy?
ops-bot: deploy streamer-miniagg v1.0 -> intake-1 (5%)
ops-bot: rollout started: 5% -> 100% in 10m if healthy
pat: initial 15m: canary p95 -20% vs baseline on short streams, writev_calls per-request -3.7x, normalize_ms median 0.08ms. one heavy tenant with 25-frame bursts saw +6% kv latency.
nico: tighten kv_miss bypass to frame_count>4 for canary and add tenant opt-out flag.
elaine: updated rules and expanded canary to 20%. new snapshot: heavy-tenant kv latency back to baseline; overall p95 -17%.
devon: PR checklist: include microbench harness, flame snapshots, config knobs host.streamer.agg_bytes, host.streamer.agg_frames, host.streamer.agg_timeout_ms, host.preproc.utf8_quickcheck, host.streamer.kv_bypass_frames, plus per-tenant opt-out. also a note in kernel-selection doc: validate host batching when enabling short-seq kernels.
pat: I'll review the PR. schedule 30m follow-up tomorrow to finalize defaults and prod roll plan. labels: perf, host-parse, grpc, kvcache.
